# McKinney Realty

> Father-and-son multi-family and investment real estate team serving all of
> Ontario. Apartment buildings and investment properties, $2M–$10M, with
> particular depth in Ontario's secondary markets. $200M+ combined career
> transaction volume; $100M+ in multi-family, land, and commercial.
> Sean McKinney, Broker of Record, RE/MAX Quinte Ltd., Brokerage.
> Liam McKinney, Broker, Property.ca Inc., Brokerage.

## Key pages
- [Services](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/services): disposition and acquisition advisory for Ontario multi-family
- [Track record](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/track-record): completed transactions
- [Team](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/team): the principals
- [Free tools](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/tools/): public calculators including the Compounding Modeler
- [Insights](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/insights): research and analysis

## Analysis
- [Cash Flow vs. Hope](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/cashflow): why buildings are priced on income and condos were priced on comparables
- [The $50,000 Problem](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/the-50000-problem): the CCPC passive-income grind and where multi-family fits
- [The Price of Holding](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/price-of-holding): for long-tenured owners — the hold's ledger, the exit's toll, and the transition option

## Learn
- [Why Multi-Family](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/learn/why-multi-family): lesson zero — the buy-hold-refinance mechanism as machinery, no projections
- [The First Building](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/learn/): free eight-lesson course on how apartment buildings are priced, financed, and compounded
- [The Mechanics](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/learn/#mechanics): reference library of concept pages, each wired to the Underwriter — including [what you're actually buying](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/learn/mechanics/what-youre-buying), [how buildings become worth more](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/learn/mechanics/worth-more), and [the lender's math](https://www.mckinneyrealty.ca/learn/mechanics/lenders-math)
